task.title: Synchronize profile lifecycle data
task.shortdesc: Use profile list, stats, read, generic CRUD, and atomic preparation endpoints without assuming bulk or cross-operation transactions.

prereq.p: Set $BPM_BASE_URL and read /openapi.json for the current ProfileCreate, ProfileUpdate, and ProfileRead shapes.

context.p: This task covers API-PROFILE-001, API-PROFILE-002, API-PROFILE-003, API-PROFILE-004, API-PROFILE-005, and the preparation commands API-PROFILE-012 and API-PROFILE-013. Store returned id and revision; do not infer identity from name alone.

step.cmd: List profiles with filters before choosing a profile to synchronize.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles?q=corp&lifecycle=active&limit=50&offset=0&sort=updated_at&order=desc. Response example: 200 ProfileRead[]. Error example: 422 for invalid typed or ranged query input.

step.cmd: Read profile statistics for the same filter context when you need counts.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/stats?q=corp&lifecycle=active. Response example: 200 {"filtered":1,"total":3}. Error example: 422 for invalid query input.

step.cmd: Read the selected profile by integer ID and include archived records only when required.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42?include_deleted=false. Response example: 200 ProfileRead with id, revision, timestamps, lifecycle, and validation state. Error example: 404 for a missing or not-visible profile; 422 for invalid path or query input.

step.cmd: Create a normalized BPM profile or use atomic preparation when BPM must compose a new baseline or duplicate.

info.p: Generic request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles with JSON {"name":"corp-baseline","schema_version":"release-153","flags":{},"compliance":{}}. Preparation request: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/prepare/new with {"name":"prepared-corp","target_schema_id":"release-153","starter_id":"basic_corporate","cis_baseline_id":"cis_l1","preparation_idempotency_key":"opaque-key"}. Duplicate adds source_id and expected_source_revision at /prepare/duplicate. Success response: 201 ProfileRead. Preparation derives policy data; do not send flags, compliance, provenance, or candidates. For a preparation 404, 409, 422, or 500, read ProfilePreparationErrorEnvelope.detail.code. Its mutation is none: no target was created and the source was not changed. Refresh stale planning, resolve a blocker or input error, and replay only the same accepted idempotency key and command identity.

step.cmd: Update mutable fields with PATCH and send expected_revision when you need optimistic concurrency.

info.p: Request example: PATCH $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42 with JSON {"description":"Reviewed by control plane","expected_revision":7}. Response example: 200 ProfileRead with incremented revision after a material update. Error examples: 400 invalid schema/profile, 404 missing or archived profile, 409 stale expected_revision, or 422 validation error.

step.cmd: Record the synchronized profile ID, revision, validation state, schema channel, and any opaque compliance metadata in the integrating product.

info.note: BPM does not provide a multi-operation transaction. If a later step fails, the integrating product owns recovery, audit records, and retry decisions.

result.p: The integration has a reproducible profile synchronization path for list, stats, read, create, and update operations.

example.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
example.p: Public preparation uses POST /api/profiles/prepare/new and POST /api/profiles/prepare/duplicate; duplicate preview is read-only at POST /api/profiles/prepare/duplicate/preview. A terminal ProfilePreparationErrorEnvelope has mutation="none": no target is created and the source is not changed. Callers do not submit flags, compliance, provenance, or a conversion candidate.

postreq.p: Use the destructive lifecycle task before archive, restore, permanent delete, or reset operations.
